newsitem.title: INDIA: Ten injured in India as blast rocks bus.
newsitem.headline: Ten injured in India as blast rocks bus.

text.p: A blast ripped through a privately owned bus in the northern Indian town of Panipat on Saturday, injuring at least 10 people, police said.
They said the blast occurred in late afternoon as the bus was parked in the main bus station of the town, some 100 km (60 miles) north of New Delhi in Haryana state.

"There is no news of any death yet," a police official told Reuters by telephone from a police station near the site of the blast. "All senior police officers have rushed to the spot. There is nothing clear yet."
No other details were immediately available.
